g.text: DAO + Template Method + Exception Translation — as built (UML 2.5.1 class diagram)
Template Method: connection, statement, parameter binding,
identity map and error translation are fixed (withStatement,
query). Subclasses add finders and may override afterLoad().
@CollectionTable sets load in ONE query per collection (no N+1).
"Is this a duplicate key?" is asked of the SqlDialect
(PostgreSQL 23505, MySQL 1062): vendor codes stay in persistence.
Same interface and the same exception types:
unit tests exercise production error paths.
